name: feat.fey-cantrip.name
editNote: Reserved Material removed: the feat's own name and its in-text mention of the fey plane's proper name both replaced with a generic descriptor; the mapped id was renamed to match, since the slug itself carried the same reserved term. Named Fey Cantrip rather than a literal translation of the printed title, because that title's most natural generic form (a two-word phrase naming the fey and magic) turned out to already occur, coincidentally, in the neighboring feat's own flavor text -- the automated page check kept mistaking that unrelated sentence for this feat's heading and relocating it a page over.
